Our services

Termite control that fits your home

Not every home needs to be fumigated. Many times a localized treatment will eliminate termites in the early stages — we recommend the best treatment method for what we actually find.

Termite Extermination

Full-service termite control using Bifen, Bora-Care and other proven treatments — knocking termites out and keeping them out.

Free Termite Inspection

A thorough inspection of your attic, crawl space, rafter tails, fascia boards and exposed wood — free, with honest recommendations.

Fumigation

Reliable, low-cost, easy fumigation when a home needs it — and an honest answer when a localized treatment will do instead.

Wood Repair & Construction

Termite-damaged wood repaired and rebuilt by our own team — so the fix is finished, not left for another contractor.

Preventative Maintenance

Annual preventative maintenance that detects re-infestation before it becomes a problem — the only sure way to protect your home.

Escrow Inspections

Termite inspections for escrow and real estate transactions across Los Angeles, Orange County and the South Bay.

About West Coast Termite

A commitment to excellence, for over 30 years

We are a locally owned and operated company in the Los Angeles and Orange County area, with over 30 years of experience. Our professionals are fully licensed, bonded and insured, and we offer affordable service plans for follow-up treatments to ensure your home stays protected.

  • Environment friendly options — Bora-Care and other green treatments that remove wood as a food source.
  • Honest and reliable — the right treatment for the problem found, nothing more.
  • Escrow inspections — trusted by buyers, sellers and agents across the South Bay.
  • Owner on the job — Brett's cell phone number is yours, night or day.
